outcome: Incidence of unintentional transvesical caesarean section
Risk factors for unintentional transvesical caesarean section
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery between January 2013 and December 2017 at a single institution (n=7,616)
finding: This study, reporting an incidence of 0.039%, is the first to assess the incidence of unintentional transvesical caesarean section, finding that risk factors are consistent with those of milder bladder injuries, and that prompt diagnosis and surgical repair seem to allow avoiding severe complications and recovery of normal urological function.
